sourcesRead.what: Current App Store description (v6.4.4, 2026-08-10), languages, devices

claims.detail: Identifies which exercise is being performed from Apple Watch wrist motion alone
claims.quote: the first app to offer automatic exercise tracking, using only the motion of your Apple Watch

claims.detail: Counts reps hands-free from watch motion
claims.quote: tracking reps for over 470 unique exercise types – completely hands free!

claims.detail: 470+ exercises auto-detected on paid tier, 180 on free tier
claims.quote: Motra Pro users have access to all 470+ auto-detected exercises, while Motra Free users have access to 180 auto-detected exercises.

claims.detail: Detection uses only watch accelerometer/gyroscope; no filming
claims.quote: Exercise auto-detection allows Motra to identify exercises using only Apple Watch wrist motion data. No video or camera is required.

claims.detail: Detects when each set begins and ends during a workout
claims.quote: During a workout, Motra detects the start and end of each set, suggests weights based on your history, and differentiates between exercise grips and variations.

claims.detail: Distinguishes grips and variations of the same exercise (e.g. close-grip vs regular)
claims.quote: Easily differentiates between exercise grips and variation for a truly accurate and customized tracking experience.

claims.feature: Detects free-weight, cable, machine and bodyweight exercises
claims.detail: Auto-tracking covers dumbbell, barbell, cable, kettlebell, machine and bodyweight movements
claims.quote: Yes, Motra can automatically track a wide range of exercises, including dumbbell, barbell, cable, kettlebell, machine, and bodyweight exercises.

claims.detail: Supersets are detected and created on the watch as you alternate exercises
claims.quote: Motra will automatically detect and create a supersets on your Apple Watch

claims.detail: Detection model adapts to the user's movement patterns over roughly 5 workouts
claims.quote: Motra’s model continuously learns from your activity, improving in accuracy over time.

claims.detail: User can turn per-user AI learning on or off
claims.quote: Toggle AI Learning on or off.

claims.detail: Clears learned movement data to restart detection calibration
claims.quote: Tap Reset Detection Cache (shown in red with a warning icon).

claims.detail: Set the fewest reps (1-8) before auto-detection registers a set
claims.quote: Tap the picker on the right side to select a value from 1 to 8.

claims.detail: Turn detection off during a workout while heart rate, calories and time keep tracking
claims.quote: You can disable auto-detection, but still keep your workout running. Your heart-rate, calories, and workout time will continue to track while auto-detection is paused.

claims.detail: Option to make every new watch workout start with auto-detection off
claims.quote: Once enabled, every new workout begins in Manual (Off).

claims.detail: Paid tier uses a newer detection model (stated 94%+ vs 80% accuracy)
claims.quote: Motra AI 2.0 — Available to premium (Pro) subscribers. Uses advanced Neural Kinetic Profiling for more accurate exercise recognition.

claims.feature: Auto-detection of custom exercises in templates
claims.detail: Custom exercises can be auto-detected when following a template
claims.quote: Improvement to support auto-detection of custom exercises when in "Template" detection mode

claims.detail: Remembers incorrect detections and user swaps to improve future detection
claims.quote: Improvements to auto-detection memory: The app will now better remember incorrect detections & swaps

claims.detail: Claims motion model provides form feedback from wrist data
claims.quote: allowing Motra to accurately track what exercise a user is doing, count their reps, and provide form-feedback.

claims.detail: Single-side exercises counted per complete both-sides movement, flagged x2
claims.quote: In exercises that involve movements on both the left and right sides independently, reps are counted using only one side.

claims.detail: Full watch app; requires Series 4 or newer and watchOS 10+
claims.quote: Our application runs on the Apple Watch Series 4 and newer.

claims.detail: Begin an empty or template workout directly on Apple Watch
claims.quote: On your Apple Watch, tap "Start a Workout > Empty Workout" to begin a session.

claims.detail: A live session is mirrored on iPhone and watch; edit or end on either
claims.quote: Any session started on either the iPhone or Apple Watch will be mirrored across both devices, allowing you to edit or end the session on either one.

claims.detail: Transfer templates to the watch to start workouts from the wrist
claims.quote: Templates can be synced to your Apple Watch for starting workouts directly from your wrist.

claims.detail: Three configurable stat slots: heart rate, volume, duration, HR zone, calories, avg rest
claims.quote: You have 3 customizable slots to select the stats you want to display.

claims.detail: View, add, edit and delete exercise notes on the watch
claims.quote: You can now view, add, edit, and delete exercise notes directly from your Apple Watch without the need of your iPhone!

claims.detail: Expand/collapse exercises in the watch workout view
claims.quote: Collapsing of exercises on the watch. You can now expand/collapse exercises on the Apple Watch as well, allowing for easier and cleaner workout management on the watch

claims.detail: Apple Watch widgets show the workout streak
claims.quote: Watch Streak Widgets: Your Apple Watch widgets now display your workout streak.

claims.detail: Watch keeps unsynced workouts up to 14 days and can re-send them
claims.quote: Your Watch stores unsaved workouts locally for up to 14 days, so you won't lose data even if sync is delayed.

claims.detail: Prompts to recover and save a freeform workout after the watch battery dies
claims.quote: You should see a prompt to recover and save the interrupted workout. Follow the on-screen instructions.

claims.detail: Records heart rate during workouts via Apple Watch
claims.quote: Motra still tracks heart rate, calories, and duration

claims.detail: Five HR zones from age-based max HR; boundaries adjustable and synced to watch
claims.quote: You can adjust the boundaries between zones by dragging the dividers in the chart.

claims.detail: Active calories measured through Apple Health/Apple Watch
claims.quote: Motra leverages Apple Health to measure and track your calories during a workout.

claims.detail: Edit a saved workout's calorie value

claims.detail: Log workouts on iPhone without an Apple Watch

claims.detail: Start an open workout with no pre-planned exercises

claims.detail: Mark sets as warm-up (WU) or cool-down (CD)

claims.detail: Mark sets as drop sets on iPhone and watch

claims.detail: Group exercises into supersets in templates or live workouts; break or swap within them

claims.detail: Groups of more than two exercises are labeled as circuits
claims.quote: Exercise groups with more than 2 exercises now show a "Circuit" label

claims.detail: Log 1-10 effort for any set

claims.detail: Rate a whole workout's effort 1-10 after finishing

notes: No features were found to be explicitly removed. Ambiguities: (1) The MCP help article says all tools are 'strictly read-only' yet lists Create/Update Template tools; 6.2.0 notes said ChatGPT was read-only with write 'coming soon'. Template creation via assistant is kept but contradictory. Multi-day plans via MCP are 'Coming Soon' and excluded. (2) AI Coach chat: 6.3.0 (2026-05-22) says rollout started 'in the coming week'; no help-centre article documents it. (3) Auto-progression article says there is 'no permanent toggle yet' for auto-detection off, but the newer auto-detection article documents an 'Always off' setting; the newer one was used. (4) 'Form feedback' is claimed only on the NKP marketing page, never in help docs. (5) 'Challenges' appear only as a notification category; no article describes the feature. (6) Exercise library size: help says 400+ (old), 5.5.0 added 1,000+; web library shows 147 pages x 12 (~1,760). (7) Platform: iPhone + Apple Watch only; help says 'available exclusively for the Apple Watch'; no Android/Google Play listing found; no web app; product page compatibility lists iPhone, Apple Watch and Apple Vision but not iPad (iPad appears only in the API supportedDevices list, likely iPhone-compat). (8) Excluded: pricing/Pro tiers, referral/affiliate, corporate wellness, rebrand, 'Spring 2026 Apparel', bug fixes, redesigned onboarding. Free-vs-Pro limits noted in details where relevant (180 vs 470+ detectable exercises, 2 templates vs unlimited, 40 custom exercises on Pro, 7-day metrics on free). (9) Website FAQ also mentions 'easy sharing of workouts via text'. (10) What's New page dates differ from App Store dates by days to weeks; App Store dates used.
